facts.value: Documents required for application for the Master of Science in Business Administration.
A bachelor's degree in a business-related program or a related field is required.
At least 90 ECTS credits in business modules must be obtained.
A minimum language level of B2 in English is required.

A complete bachelor's degree in English, standardized language test with proof of B2 level, English course at university with explicit B2 level, or Abitur certificate if English was taken up to secondary school.
Language proofs must not be older than 5 years.
Semester abroad, individual English modules in bachelor, university language courses without explicit level, CET-4, or CET-6.
Cambridge Certificate (First Certificate in English A-C), DAAD language certificate B2, IELTS Academic (minimum 5.0), LCCI (EFB Level 3), TOEFL (minimum 72), TOEIC (minimum 785), UNIcert II.
A current CV outlining significant stages of education and professional experience is required.
A simple copy of your university entrance qualification (e.g., Abitur certificate) is needed.
International applicants must prove that they have passed the DSH-2 exam within the application deadline.
Exemptions from DSH-2 may apply for TestDaF, Goethe Certificate C2, KMK exam, and other recognized qualifications.
For information regarding the DSH exam and preparatory courses, refer to the university website.
Applicants who completed their bachelor's degree in Vietnam, China, or India need an APS certificate.
